properties.name: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco
Pacific Gas and Electric Company General Office Building
Pacific Gas and Electric Company General Office Building Annex

properties.label: Courtyard Entrance stairs
properties.basis: OSM steps w941650785 at the tower's SW face, beside the fountain and the Chipotle; matches the 2025 AICamp event page. Event page may be dated.

properties.label: Courtyard fountain
properties.basis: OSM amenity=fountain w941650782, about 20 m west of the stairs.

properties.label: Plaza at the foot of the tower (Ecker Plaza)
properties.basis: Midpoint of the OSM pedestrian way named Ecker Plaza (w8917670), which runs along the tower's SW face; the unnamed place=square polygon w132127550 covers the same open space.

properties.label: Market Street sidewalk (525 Market frontage)
properties.basis: Tower's NW face looks onto Market Street. OSM does not map the sidewalk on this frontage as its own way, so the point is 5 m outside the face.

properties.label: 1st Street sidewalk (tower's NE face)
properties.basis: OSM sidewalk w772259114 runs along the tower's NE face on 1st Street.

properties.label: Stevenson Street (back of the tower)
properties.basis: Nearest point on OSM Stevenson Street to the tower's SE face. Whether the freight lift or a service door opens here is not verified.

properties.label: Muni stop, Market St & 1st St
properties.basis: OSM stop at Market & 1st, about 40 m from the tower (venue.md: Muni at Market and First).

properties.label: Nearest BART/Muni entrance (BART/Muni elevator)
properties.basis: Nearest public subway_entrance node in the OSM extract; Montgomery St station is west of the tower.

properties.label: Salesforce Transit Center
properties.basis: OSM building w542375290, one block south-east (outside the 250 m core, inside the window).
